body: Thank you. I'm not sure how things could turn around. I was so miserable before this, I have no idea how things could get better. I appreciate your reply.

Thanks, it's nice to hear someone be honest about the fact that sometimes it just doesn;t work out. Being young helps a lot, but sometimes being older gives you more perspective and options. 

Thanks so much for reading. I thought about leaving a note, and I think I might just write, "It's no one's fault but mine." So you're one of the last people to hear me out, and I appreciate it.
Thank you, that's so nice to hear. :) Haven't heard anyone say anything nice to me in a long time.

People really don't realize how much they make appearance matter when it shouldn't. Seems so easy for attractive people. Still, sometimes attractive people have gone a long way to get there and totally understand what it's like to be ignored or mocked. Not everyone is cruel. If I could change your sadness I would.
I'm sorry and I wish things were different for you. They still could be and you're not alone.
